visual_name: Day in the life, part sixteen: the welcome pack (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js classroom with a rewritten chalkboard, box-built character, a falling handbook, welcome email / webinar player / quiz paper / Getting started levels / level one opened, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 37.9 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a welcome pack of a ninety page handbook (it lands on his desk), a two hour webinar with a Tuesdays-only replay, and a quiz he scores 4/20 on; then YourBrand's Getting started: three levels, five minutes each, finish one to unlock the next, every step linking to its page. He fails their quiz again on purpose.
